svg.text: Producers write each event to an outbox in the same transaction as the change, then publish it; every subscribing service gets its own durable queue, delivered to one ready replica.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Subscribers: Notification (push), Tamagotchi (owner transfer and XP), User Management (currency), Guild (user.deleted) and Monster Raid (raid definitions) — each idempotent on the event id.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prometheus scrapes GET /metrics of the Broker, the Gateway, Service Discovery and every replica; Grafana Alloy ships every container's JSON log lines to Loki.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grafana shows the Broker, domain-service and log dashboards; the Gateway's GET /api/v1/gateway/logs downloads the same logs.
